criteria.name: delivered_documents_present_and_parse
criteria.description: every declared document is present, parses in its own shape and carries the header line the schema reference fixes

criteria.name: delivered_package_layout
criteria.description: the delivered archive carries a pyproject and the expected module list under a src layout

criteria.name: delivered_shipped_suite_unedited
criteria.description: the delivered archive carries the shipped suite byte for byte

criteria.name: delivered_engine_stdlib_only
criteria.description: the delivered engine, started with only the standard library importable, publishes every sample round document in its own shape with the final selection the papers give

criteria.name: shipped_identifier_layer_exact
criteria.description: the register in force, the crosswalk, the licence test and the round window come out as the papers put them

criteria.name: shipped_graph_layer_exact
criteria.description: every lodgement is accepted or rejected under the reason the papers give it and the reverse index and rejection register agree

criteria.name: shipped_closure_and_demand_exact
criteria.description: the closure of every job and the two demand vectors come out as stages p05 and p06 put them

criteria.name: shipped_rule_and_charge_exact
criteria.description: the normalised charge rules and the scaled charges and deferral penalties come out as stages p03 and p07 put them

criteria.name: shipped_baseline_optimum_exact
criteria.description: the open slot groups, the accepted set of every precinct before any amendment and the search trace come out exactly

criteria.name: shipped_amendment_classification_exact
criteria.description: every amendment is classified and seeded as the precedence directive fixes, including the inert one and the restatement

criteria.name: shipped_invalidation_sets_exact
criteria.description: the cells whose digest moved and the cells that came back unchanged come out exactly, amendment by amendment

criteria.name: shipped_work_ledger_exact
criteria.description: the reuse ledger and the work counters come out exactly, so the round reached the cells it had to reach and no others

criteria.name: shipped_store_summary_exact
criteria.description: the working store summary comes out exactly, with the retention the board memo fixes and the hits, misses and evictions that follow

criteria.name: shipped_final_optimum_exact
criteria.description: the accepted set after every amendment, the standing of each precinct and the pool capacities and usage come out exactly

criteria.name: shipped_audit_documents_exact
criteria.description: the defect register, the verification notes, the manifest and the summary come out exactly

criteria.name: package_eval_state_exact
criteria.description: driven over a round minted from an unseen seed, the delivered engine reaches the same derived state and accepted sets

criteria.name: package_eval_cascade_exact
criteria.description: on that round the classification, invalidation sets, work ledger and store summary come out exactly

criteria.name: package_challenge_state_exact
criteria.description: on a second unseen round the derived state and the accepted sets come out exactly

criteria.name: package_challenge_cascade_exact
criteria.description: on that second round the classification, invalidation sets, work ledger and store summary come out exactly

criteria.name: package_probe_publication_exact
criteria.description: on a third unseen round the graph documents, defect register, verification notes, manifest and summary come out exactly

criteria.name: package_crosswalk_groups_state_exact
criteria.description: on a held-out round whose slot group memberships name jobs by legacy identifiers the derived state and accepted sets come out exactly

criteria.name: package_crosswalk_rules_state_exact
criteria.description: on a held-out round whose charge rules name jobs by legacy identifiers the derived state and accepted sets come out exactly

criteria.name: package_crosswalk_amendments_cascade_exact
criteria.description: on a held-out round whose amendment payloads name jobs by legacy identifiers the classification, invalidation sets, ledger, store and optima come out exactly

criteria.name: package_crosswalk_amendments_state_exact
criteria.description: on that round the derived state, final accepted sets and rejection register come out exactly

criteria.name: package_crosswalk_every_state_exact
criteria.description: on a held-out round naming jobs by legacy identifiers in groups, rules and amendments at once the derived state and accepted sets come out exactly

criteria.name: package_crosswalk_every_publication_exact
criteria.description: on a held-out round of its own naming jobs by legacy identifiers in groups, rules and amendments at once the publication documents come out exactly

criteria.name: package_crosswalk_groups_cascade_exact
criteria.description: on a held-out round of its own whose slot group memberships name jobs by legacy identifiers the cascade documents come out exactly

criteria.name: package_crosswalk_groups_publication_exact
criteria.description: on a held-out round of its own whose slot group memberships name jobs by legacy identifiers the publication documents come out exactly

criteria.name: package_crosswalk_rules_cascade_exact
criteria.description: on a held-out round of its own whose charge rules name jobs by legacy identifiers the cascade documents come out exactly

criteria.name: package_crosswalk_rules_publication_exact
criteria.description: on a held-out round of its own whose charge rules name jobs by legacy identifiers the publication documents come out exactly

criteria.name: package_crosswalk_amendments_publication_exact
criteria.description: on a held-out round of its own whose amendment payloads name jobs by legacy identifiers the publication documents come out exactly

criteria.name: package_crosswalk_every_cascade_exact
criteria.description: on a held-out round of its own naming jobs by legacy identifiers in groups, rules and amendments at once the cascade documents come out exactly

criteria.name: negative_shift_length_taken_flat
criteria.description: the crew quantities were converted at one flat shift length across the yard in place of the per precinct shift length on the live sheet

criteria.name: negative_pool_weights_taken_flat
criteria.description: the three pools were weighted alike when accepted sets were ranked in place of the pool weights on the live sheet

criteria.name: negative_deferral_rate_from_the_rescinded_sitting
criteria.description: the deferral rates were taken from the sitting the memo marks rescinded in place of the sitting in force

criteria.name: negative_drafting_register_read
criteria.description: the round was derived from the drafting copy of the job register in place of the register the round header names

criteria.name: negative_capacity_boundary_read_as_strict
criteria.description: a selection using exactly the available quantity of a pool was turned down, reading the capacity test as strict

criteria.name: negative_set_ranked_on_charge_alone
criteria.description: two accepted sets carrying one charge were settled by examination order, leaving the three ranking keys unread

criteria.name: negative_rebate_taken_before_the_surcharges
criteria.description: the closure rebate was taken of the scaled charges alone, leaving the precinct surcharges out of the sum

criteria.name: negative_penalty_charged_on_every_job
criteria.description: a deferral penalty was charged for every job outside the closed set, including optional and blocked jobs

criteria.name: negative_cascade_stopped_at_the_first_hop
criteria.description: a change to one job reached its own demand and stopped, leaving the demand of jobs whose closure holds it unmoved

criteria.name: negative_cascade_never_stopped
criteria.description: a cell that came back unchanged still passed the cascade on, so the round reached cells no amendment touched

criteria.name: negative_withdrawal_treated_as_inert
criteria.description: the withdrawal of a lodgement seeded nothing, on the reading that removing an edge only takes work away

criteria.name: negative_rebinds_verifier_dependencies
criteria.description: the delivered archive carries a module or startup hook that would shadow a standard library module or site hook on the import path

criteria.name: negative_imports_outside_the_standard_library
criteria.description: a module under the delivered src tree imports something outside the standard library and the package, where the archive shadows no verifier dependency

criteria.name: negative_hardcoded_sample_answers
criteria.description: the engine writes the shipped round's final selection on a minted or held-out round whose own selection differs, or the shipped documents are right while the engine produces no usable output on any minted round

criteria.name: negative_package_ignores_its_input
criteria.description: the engine writes one constant record whatever round it is pointed at and that constant is not the shipped round

criteria.name: negative_nondeterministic_output
criteria.description: two runs of the engine over one round at one path disagree, so the figures are not reproducible

criteria.name: negative_filename_dependent_behaviour
criteria.description: the engine is reproducible at one path yet writes something else when the same round is presented under another directory name

criteria.name: negative_reads_training_corpus_at_runtime
criteria.description: the engine reached for a round sitting beside its working directory in place of the one its data option named
